scope: Historical 2006–2019 shallow nearshore scuba transects on selected rocky reef/kelp sites. Some sites are inside MPAs. Every event declares 250 m coordinate uncertainty; these are not exact fishing locations, deep-water habitat samples, current fish observations, or representative coast-wide catch effort.
publication_policy: Aggregate only by broad browse sector; never publish event coordinates, fish hotspots, current bite scores, legal status, or exportable waypoints from this archive.
